title: The Luminous Tree Expedition

scenes.text: Dr. Jacob travels to a mysterious island to study rare plants.
scenes.image_prompt: scientist explorer standing at jungle edge with notebook

scenes.text: Sebastian secretly follows Jacob, planning to sabotage his work.
scenes.image_prompt: sneaky rival hiding behind jungle trees watching explorers

scenes.text: Jacob and Asha venture deeper and discover a glowing tree.
scenes.image_prompt: huge glowing magical tree in jungle clearing

scenes.text: Sebastian reveals himself, creating tension and danger.
scenes.image_prompt: night jungle camp confrontation between explorers

scenes.text: Jacob protects the discovery, ensuring it is used responsibly.

story: Dr. Jacob explores a jungle island and discovers a glowing tree with the help of Asha. A rival tries to interfere, but Jacob remains focused on protecting the discovery. The story shows the importance of integrity in science.
